column1: # One source of truth for scripts/download_models.sh and scripts/serve_models.sh.
# Download order is file order (victim + red first: smallest, needed earliest).
# role           port  served_names        util  tool_parser  repo                                                revision

# 0.45 not 0.40: weights are 45 GiB on disk, 0.40 of ~120 GiB would leave ~3 GiB for KV
# BLUE_FALLBACK=1: answers to both names, so Settings.blue and Settings.blue_fallback resolve
